name: Voeux
source:
In a world of ruin, a towering carnival appears. Haunted. Dangerous. Yet you are drawn inside.

You have a wish.

[From [url=https://avior.itch.io/voeux]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一片廢墟之中，一座高聳的遊樂場拔地而起。裡面鬧鬼，十分危險。可你還是被吸引著走了進去。

你有一個願望。

［摘自[url=https://avior.itch.io/voeux]Itch.io[/url]］
